title: SignalTerrain
lead: One calm place to open each day: a cyber awareness brief from verified public sources — what changed, why it matters, who may be affected, and defensive next steps. Not a news feed, not a SIEM, not offensive security.
mission: Defensive-minded professionals and serious amateurs who need trustworthy public-source cyber context without hype, fear, or attack tooling.
problems: Public cyber news is noisy and often hyped
People need sourced priorities and defensive guidance — not exploit kits or SIEM consoles
Sample demos must never be mistaken for live intelligence

capabilityGroups.title: Cyber Awareness (live)
capabilityGroups.description: Dashboard and live brief from verified public sources with trust labels, refresh time, and provider health. Educational and defensive only.
items: Adaptive Defense from live public intelligence

capabilityGroups.title: Archive · teaching only
capabilityGroups.description: Historical literacy samples stay behind an explicit archive section — never substituted for live intelligence and not in primary product nav.

capabilityGroups.title: Radio & spectrum (later)
capabilityGroups.description: RF literacy tools remain on the roadmap and are not part of the current cyber-brief product path.

principles: Four questions: what changed, why it matters, who is affected, what should happen next
Evidence and trust labels over fear or hype
Live means a fresh public-source artifact — stale data is labeled Stale, not Live
Samples are labeled samples and stay out of the ordinary product click path
Educational cyber awareness only — not scanning, offense, SOC, IDS, or IPS
Never fabricate signals, incidents, threat levels, or world attack maps

modules.title: Cyber intelligence dashboard
modules.description: First product dashboard — CISA KEV, NIST NVD, CISA advisories, source health.

modules.title: Cyber Live intelligence
modules.description: Verified public sources — daily brief with priority, trust, freshness, and provider health.

modules.title: Adaptive Defense
modules.description: Explainable defensive attention from live public intelligence — devices are never inspected.

privacyPhilosophy: Persona preferences stay in your browser. Precise locations are not required for the cyber brief. Archive teaching samples are labeled and never presented as live intelligence.
futureDirection: Radio & spectrum literacy and deeper cyber topic coverage remain carefully bounded future phases — educational, never offensive.
